diagnosis.root_cause: A product-api refactor deployed around 10:20 caused cache-hit rates to collapse from ~94% to ~3%, driving a massive increase in read load and spiking p95 latency from ~180ms to over 3200ms.
evidence: Database team reports product-api read load is way up
product-api p95_latency_ms spiked from 177.39ms to 3259.07ms following the deploy
product-api cache_hit_rate dropped from 0.9437 to 0.0296 starting immediately after the 10:20 deploy
diagnosis.recommended_fix: Roll back the product-api refactor deployed at 10:20 to restore caching functionality and bring read load and latency back to normal levels. Follow up by investigating the caching logic regression in the refactored code.

evidence.plan_reasoning: Product-api read load spiked immediately after a 10:20 refactor, so we should query its latency and cache hit rate metrics between 10:15 and 10:40 to understand the impact of the change.
We confirmed product-api latency spiked significantly starting at 10:24. Next, we should check product-api's cache_hit_rate metric to see if the refactor caused caching to fail.
